rationale.finding: A modern causative verb-forming prefix and a current adjective base supply a meaningful reading equivalent to making a result or condition certain. Whole-word Oxford/Collins definitions and the independently accepted result-focused example fit that reading. Collins's explicit historical en-/sure connection corroborates rather than independently proves the modern analysis.
rationale.alternatives: The entire ensure form is supplied in ensure.atomic-alternative.proposed.json as a nonselected fallback, not a second simultaneously active analysis.
rationale.limits: Do not read sure solely as someone's confidence or equate ensuring a condition with checking evidence, assuring a person, making a guarantee in law or providing insurance. Those lexical/specialist families are outside the accepted sense.

rationale.finding: The selected present-day information-transfer meaning is best kept intact in this candidate. Historical formation from an into-prefix and shape/form base does not yield the accepted meaning by an ordinary negative-prefix or document-form rule. Verb forms independently show informed, supporting a derivative relationship without requiring an internal split of inform.
rationale.limits: Atomic is an authored pedagogical boundary. A formal linguistic analysis may recognize inherited structure. No lexical level, phrase, clinical consent or media gate is changed by choosing an intact base.

rationale.finding: Selected gathering meaning and transparent collected/collecting derivatives support retaining collect as the base. Latin col-/com- and legere/collect- history is genuine. A separate classical lesson would require explicit root meaning, assimilation/allomorph evidence and pedagogical review; a syllable division or visible col+lect string is insufficient.
rationale.limits: The candidate does not deny historical internal structure or prohibit a future sourced classical-root lesson. It excludes pickup/payment and all existing collection compound approvals.

ensure.existing_en_family: affix.en.prefix / en is currently used by pending encode and enable. That underspecified legacy identity is not declared wrong, split, renamed or approved here. Future reuse requires independent selected-sense review.
ensure.excluded: Greek-location english.affix.en.in in empathy and Germanic suffix -en are not the same identity as this causative prefix. Shared letter shapes never authorize equivalence.

inform.held_identity: morph.inform / inform in pending informed consent
inform.reason: Identical spelling and the ordinary inform/informed relationship make a future shared base plausible. The clinical adjective and consent phrase also require understanding and context, so lexical relationship alone does not approve their full graph or specialist meaning.
future_options: Retain separate provisional IDs until independent morphology and clinical-family decisions are complete.

After such review, explicitly map only the accepted same-sense base occurrences to one canonical identity, preserving whole-graph and clinical review gates pending where appropriate. This research performs no remap.
inform.standalone_adjective: The separate clinical informed adjective has null morphology in the immutable corpus; it is not filled or approved here.

collect.held_identity: morph.collect / collect in current gathering draft and two pickup compounds
collect.reason: Sense-qualified teaching identity prevents an automatic same-spelling tile equivalence with pending waste-pickup uses. The related morph.collection pickup/payment compounds and any future collection decomposition remain separate decisions.
collect.limits: Changing the analysis part identity does not change collect.gather.v or migrate its accumulated lexical skills. The accepted same-ID gathering repair retains its separate historical-evidence caveat.

runtime_implications.type_does_not_isolate: scripts/morphology_analysis.gd:87-90 hashes canonical_id and canonical form, deliberately excluding atomic/stem type. Notes or a type change alone cannot prevent shared tile compatibility.
runtime_implications.pending_gate: compile normally rejects pending morphology; these research candidates are not playable and do not bypass that gate.
runtime_implications.atomic_exposure: An intact atomic target produces whole-form exposure, not assessed spelling/composition mastery. The resolver omits Word Jelly spelling from atomic term requirements, so inform and collect need independently valid scored routes such as their accepted local phrase focuses.
runtime_implications.variant: The accepted ensure lexical projection includes both ensure and insure. The one-graph morphology contract requires exact canonical text ensure; this proposal neither removes insure nor treats its letters as negative in-.
runtime_implications.readiness: Image/audio, expression audio, practice reachability, module readiness and release remain independently pending; no split is manufactured to unlock an exercise.
